visual.general_description: Graphical abstract summarising a 7-patient simplified LCSD case series with printed statistics and two before/after bar charts.
visual.detailed_description: Rectangular graphical abstract with a title bar reading "Simplified Left Cardiac Sympathetic Denervation as an Acute Strategy for Recurrent Ventricular Tachycardia in Multimorbid Patients with Structural Heart Disease – A Case Series". A left box shows black silhouettes of two elderly people with walking aids under the text "7 Multimorbid Patients with SHD underwent simplified LCSD", an ECG-style rhythm strip, the text "After failed treatment with", a downward arrow, and two icons labelled "AADs" (capsule and tablet) and "VT-Ablation" (a colourful electroanatomic map). A right-hand box holds the text "4 Patients with electrical storm mean age 75.9 ± 6.7 years mean LVEF 30.7 ± 10.9%) procedure duration of 20.7 ± 5.3 min. Follow Up 7 ± 2.6 months", with a right-pointing arrow to a small thoracoscopic photograph captioned "Simplified LCSD via VATS". Below, the underlined text "no major complications or Horner's syndrome!" sits above two bar charts: "Median VT Therapies" (light blue bars, Number of Events axis ticks 0, 20 and 40, bracket labelled "p = 0,022") and "Median ICD Shocks" (light green bars, axis ticks 0, 2, 4 and 6, bracket labelled "p = 0,035"). Each chart has a Before LCSD bar and an After LCSD bar with error bars; the After LCSD bar is lower than the Before LCSD bar in both, and no bar is visible above the baseline for After LCSD in the shocks chart.
